mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, signaling weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 50,000 persons (PAYEMS < 50.0) signals weak labor market growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 50.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL > 237.0) and stable or rising FEDFUNDS (FEDFUNDS > 0.3%) signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 237.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (regime_hint), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.5%) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.5%.
